location: Stranglethorn Vale, under water off the west coast
entrance: Under water off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale, around /way 21.4 27.9. Swim past The Vile Reef to the Sunken Hollow, near the island with the water elementals, and look for a cave with a large tablet beside it.

95788.objective: Collect 5 I'lalai Fetishes from the trolls in the Drowned City.
95788.note: From Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore, after Troll Witchery. Afterwards The Web of Magic takes the fetish to Abra Cadabra in Dalaran.

95787.objective: Make rubbings of the four Tablets of I'lalai in the Drowned City with the hide and charcoal you get with the quest.
95787.note: From Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore, after Troll Witchery. The rewards come with the follow-up Findings for the Explorer's League, at Historian Karnik in Ironforge.

95775.objective: Make rubbings of the four Tablets of I'lalai in the Drowned City with the hide and charcoal you get with the quest.
95775.note: From Kin'weelay in Grom'gol, after The Vile Reef. The Horde version of Take Two With Water.

95776.objective: Kill Var'Taka in the Drowned City.
95776.note: From Commander Aggro'gosh in Grom'gol, after The Vile Reef and Enemies in the Water. Var'Taka is the second boss.

96774.objective: Recover an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City.
96774.note: From Mazu'kon of the Earthen Ring.

97130.objective: Recover an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City.
97130.note: From Archmage Timear in Dalaran, for both factions. The same task as Ancient Gurubashi Idol for the Horde.

95789.objective: Collect 10 Voodoo-Infused Artifacts from the Saltseer pirates in the Drowned City.
95789.note: From Krazek in Booty Bay, for both factions.

95791.objective: Kill 3 Saltseer Coroners and Captain Dreadrise in the Drowned City.
95791.note: From Krazek in Booty Bay, for both factions. Captain Dreadrise is the fourth boss.
